rows.en: <operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>...A man capable of pulling off an operation on this scale. That's the one we're about to fight.
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Char Aznable<ce()>, huh. Heh... honestly, it's got me a little rattled.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>After going to such lengths, he set up a flashy grand stage and threw down the gauntlet.
rows.notes: Referent 'he' = Char, named in the previous row.

rows.en: <operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Guess your rival really is something else.
rows.notes: Addressed to Amuro, who replies next; 'your rival' = Char.

rows.en: <operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>This is it. I will take him down... no matter what.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>If we all pool our strength, we can handle something like Axis!
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>We've gotten through all kinds of things so far. We can pull this off, I know it!
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Char<ce()>... if I don't finish him, I won't be able to rest easy.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Captain <color(4)>Amuro<ce()>... please don't say such ominous things.
rows.notes: Japanese order 'Amuro Captain' flipped to 'Captain Amuro'; color tag kept on the name.

rows.en: <operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>You're the one who's carried our fight this whole time.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Can't have you dying easy in a place like this.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>I was only saying I'm prepared for it.
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Tapp<ce()>, <color(4)>Light<ce()>. We're gonna make it back, right?
<operator(10020,1)><speed(2)>You're more serious than usual. Nothing scares us with the three of us together, right?
<operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>Guess that's simply an ace's fate.
<operator(10040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Kaine<ce()>. That's not like you. Right now we need that boldness of yours.
<operator(10010,2)><speed(2)>Yeah, you're right... Let's go show 'em what we've got!!
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Isamu<ce()>! You ready!
<operator(25010,2)><speed(2)>You've got a different fire today, <color(4)>Guld<ce()>.
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)>People here crossed the boundaries between their own races and stood together. I won't let anyone destroy that!
rows.notes: 'joined hands' reworded to 'stood together' to avoid the letter j per the style rule.

rows.en: <operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Not bad, coming from you for once. <color(4)>Guld<ce()>... we'll stop it, no matter what.
rows.notes: 'it' = the Axis drop; the source's 'yatsu' object is left as the team's shared goal, not a person.

rows.en: <operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>If we let Axis fall here, it's a repeat of that nightmare fifteen years ago.
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>A tragedy like that... never again...
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Jamil<ce()>, leave it to us! We will stop it, no matter what!
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>What you're feeling... we've made it our own!
<operator(17020,2)><speed(2)>Yeah! Let's show 'em! This time, it's not about the money.
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>Everyone... please, stay safe.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Let's nail this all the way to the end!
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Of course! <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>, you're okay, right?
<operator(23020,2)><speed(2)>I'm okay! <color(4)>Nirvash<ce()> is fired up too! It can feel everyone's feelings!
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Gainer<ce()>! You ready to go!
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Of course! What about you, though? You gonna be all right?
<operator(21020,2)><speed(2)>Obviously! I've got to see this to the end with my own eyes!
<operator(21020,2)><speed(2)>This is the biggest task of Exodus contractor <color(4)>Gain Bijou<ce()>'s career!
<operator(21150,1)><speed(2)>"A fight worth risking my life for"... please, I'm not betting that easy.
<operator(23200,1)><speed(2)>That's right! We've got a fun future ahead of us.
<operator(19010,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Kei<ce()>, <color(4)>Gai<ce()>, let's go. Time to show them the power of Getter!
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>Yeah! Like we'd lose to some hunk of rock!
<operator(19030,1)><speed(2)>Yeaaaah, let's do this!!
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>For the people waiting back on Earth too... I will stop Axis, no matter what!
<operator(14030,1)><speed(2)>That's one huge target! Miss it and a pay cut won't even cover it!
<operator(14010,1)><speed(2)>All right, let's go, everyone!
<operator(12061,1)><speed(2)>I'm fired up, fired up! The decisive battle for Earth's fate! In manga terms, maybe the final chapter?
<operator(12071,1)><speed(2)>Please look forward to <color(4)>Hikaru Amano<ce()>-sensei's next work.
rows.notes: '-sensei' kept; it is part of the manga-artist in-joke, not a bare address honorific.

rows.en: <operator(6011,1)><speed(2)>Output, drive system, control system... all normal.
<operator(6011,1)><speed(2)>Let's go, <color(4)>Zero<ce()>...!
rows.notes: 'Zero' = Heero's Wing Gundam Zero, used as a short pet name for the unit.

rows.en: <operator(12051,2)><speed(2)>Damn you, <color(5)>Char<ce()>! I'll never forgive you! There's no way I'm letting Axis fall!
<operator(12061,1)><speed(2)>Oh! You're really fired up, <color(4)>Ryoko<ce()>!
rows.notes: '-chan' dropped per convention of dropping honorifics with no English equivalent.

rows.en: <operator(12051,1)><speed(2)>Damn right! If not now, then when the hell would I be?!
<operator(12061,1)><speed(2)>True! It's the decisive battle for Earth's fate, after all! Final chapter material, huh?
<operator(12071,1)><speed(2)>Please look forward to <color(4)>Hikaru Amano<ce()>-sensei's next work.
<operator(12051,1)><speed(2)>Before that next work, gotta take out the bad guys first!
<operator(19050,1)><speed(2)>We stopped the last day of Earth once already. Gotta show we can stop this crisis too.
<operator(19040,1)><speed(2)>Heh... obviously.
<operator(19060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Ryoma<ce()>... I'm counting on you.
<operator(16010,1)><speed(2)>I have to stop it here... I can't let King <color(5)>Sakomizu<ce()>'s wishes go to waste!
<operator(16040,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Asap<ce()>. Please come back to me. If <color(4)>Asap<ce()>'s not here anymore, I...
rows.notes: Source repeats the addressee's name (not 'you') under two separate color tags; both kept per the tag-order rule.

rows.en: <operator(16010,1)><speed(2)>It's okay! I promise I'll come back!

uncertainties.issue: Subject of 'threw down the gauntlet' left as 'he' (Char); source omits it but the surrounding rows name Char.
'yatsu' (the thing/guy to stop) left as 'it', read as the Axis drop rather than a person, since no singular enemy is named in this exchange.
Source names 'Asap' twice instead of using 'you' the second time; kept literal to match the two color tags.

meaning_fixes.before: I was just saying I'm prepared for it.
meaning_fixes.after: I was only saying I'm prepared for it.
meaning_fixes.reason: reword to remove lowercase 'j' per style rule; no meaning change.

meaning_fixes.before: Guess that's just an ace's fate.
meaning_fixes.after: Guess that's simply an ace's fate.
meaning_fixes.reason: reword to remove lowercase 'j' per style rule; no meaning change.

checked_decisions: 0/21 'he' = Char: source omits the subject of 'threw down the gauntlet', but 0/20 names Char Aznable immediately before, and 0/22-23 keep discussing 'your rival'/'him' consistently. Accepted.

1/142 'yatsu' -> 'it' read as the Axis drop, not a person: block is Guld/Isamu discussing protecting the unity between races; no singular named enemy in this exchange and the wider scene is about stopping Axis's fall. Accepted, matches draft's own reasoning.
1/620 Source repeats 'Asap' instead of using 'you' for the second mention; kept literal (two separate <color(4)>Asap<ce()> tags in source, order preserved). Accepted.

Orchestrator decisions: Amuro's rank as 'Captain' used correctly at 1/60 ('Captain Amuro'). 'Hikaru Amano-sensei' in-joke (1/460, 1/543) kept as drafted. Ixbrau/New Federation/unidentified life-forms do not appear in this scene. Speaker tags left unchanged throughout.
remaining_uncertainties: None beyond what the draft already flagged in its own 'uncertainties' list (0/21 referent, 1/142 'it' referent, 1/620 repeated name) — all checked and accepted as-is; no row in this scene could not be verified.
